description: Land Acquisition - Maththumagala, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific parcels of land are needed for a public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of 89 land lots with their boundaries, extents, and locations. The content is exclusively about land matters (acquisition for public purpose) and does not involve government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any other specialized category besides land-related administrative matters.
